versions.changelog:
Initial release: WhatsApp Business API integration with managed OAuth.

- Send messages (text, template, image, document, video, audio, location, contact, interactive) via WhatsApp Business API
- Manage OAuth connections through a user portal
- Supports specifying active connections for multi-account use
- Uses Maton API Key for authentication and access control
- Provides easy-to-follow code samples and detailed API reference
